about: ALTER presets. scripts/alter_prompt.py builds every prompt from this file: the mode's opening block, the preset's change line, then the close block. {who} is the person or subject as seen in the source; every other {key} is listed in the preset's fill.

openings.O: Edit @video1. Keep absolutely everything exactly the same, frame for frame: {who} (face, body, every movement and expression), the camera movement, framing and lens, the set, the light and the timing.
openings.M: Edit @video1. Keep exactly the same camera movement, framing, timing and every movement, gesture and expression of {who}, frame for frame.
openings.R: Restyle @video1 completely into {style}. Redraw every part of every frame in this style, {who} and the whole background alike; nothing may stay photographic: no photo texture, no lens look, no film grain. Keep exactly the same camera movement, framing, timing and every movement of {who}, frame for frame.
openings.R_photo: Restyle @video1 completely into {style}. Keep exactly the same camera movement, framing, timing and every movement of {who}, frame for frame.

close.O: Nothing else changes. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
close.M: Nothing else changes. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
close.R: It must look like a version of the shot made from scratch in this style, not a filter over the video. No text, no letters, no logos.
close.R_photo: No text, no letters, no logos.

presets.name: product-swap
presets.change: Change only the {object} in the hand: it becomes the {product} from @image1, held exactly the same way at the same size, printed and lit exactly as in @image1.

fill.object: what is held now, e.g. white paper coffee cup
fill.product: the new product, e.g. slim cream drinks can with a blue circle

refs: target frame: a frame of this shot with the new product already in the hand

presets.name: label-redesign
presets.change: Change only the printed artwork on the {container}: it looks exactly like @image1, printed for real on the material, following its curve, with the same highlights, condensation and frost on top of the print.
refs: target frame: a frame of this shot with the new artwork printed on

presets.name: colourway
presets.change: Change only the colour of the {object} to {colour}, same material, same finish, same reflections, as in @image1.
refs: target frame in the new colour

presets.name: de-logo
presets.change: Remove every logo, brand mark, word and number from the {object}; the surfaces stay plain, same material and colour.

presets.name: prop-swap
presets.change: The {prop} becomes the {new_prop} from @image1, same size in the hand, moving exactly as the original does.
refs: the new prop, alone on a plain background or in a frame of this shot

presets.name: device-swap
presets.change: The {device} becomes the {new_device} from @image1, same grip, same screen angle; the screen shows {screen}.

fill.screen: plain light or a dark screen

refs: target frame with the new device in the hand

presets.name: food-drink-swap
presets.change: The {food} becomes the {new_food} from @image1, same portion size, same steam or condensation, same way of eating or drinking.

fill.new_food: e.g. bowl of ramen with a soft egg

refs: target frame with the new food or drink

presets.name: vehicle-swap
presets.change: The {vehicle} becomes the {new_vehicle} from @image1, same path, speed, lane and reflections; no badges, no plate text.
refs: the new vehicle, ideally a render or photo from a similar angle

presets.name: shoe-swap
presets.change: The shoes become the {shoes} from @image1, plain uppers with no logos, stars, stripes or patches, same steps and ground contact.
refs: target frame with the new shoes on the feet

presets.name: accessory-swap
presets.change: Add or change only the {accessory} to the one in @image1, sitting naturally and moving with the body.
refs: the accessory, or a target frame with it worn

presets.name: outfit
presets.change: Change only the clothes to the outfit in @image1, which is a frame of this same shot: {outfit}. Same fit to the body, the fabric moving and creasing naturally with every movement.

fill.outfit: e.g. a long camel wool overcoat, open, over a white t-shirt

refs: target frame: this shot's frame with the new outfit on

presets.name: costume
presets.change: The clothes become {costume} as in @image1, worn naturally, same movement.
refs: target frame with the costume on

presets.name: season-outfit
presets.change: Dress {who} for {season}: {clothes}, same movement; the set and light stay as they are.

fill.clothes: e.g. a puffer coat and a knitted scarf

presets.name: hair-makeup
presets.change: Change only the hair to {hair} and the makeup to {makeup}, as in @image1; face, expression and identity unchanged.
refs: target frame with the new hair and makeup

presets.name: recast
presets.change: The person becomes the person in @image1, which is a frame of this same shot: {new_person}. Same movements, expressions and lip movements; the clothes, the set and the light stay exactly as in @video1.

fill.new_person: who they become: age, face, hair, skin, build

refs: target frame: this shot's frame with the new person in the same clothes

presets.name: creature
presets.change: {who} becomes {creature} from @image1, real anatomy and weight, matching every movement and timing.
refs: the creature, full body

presets.name: animal-swap
presets.change: The {animal} becomes a {new_animal} from @image1, real fur and anatomy, same run, same path, same timing.
refs: the new animal, full body

presets.name: mascot-3d
presets.change: {who} becomes the 3D animated character in @image1, feature-film rendering, same performance.
refs: the character, full body

presets.name: game-character
presets.change: {who} becomes the game character in @image1 (exact costume, colours, proportions), performing exactly the same movements.
refs: the character sheet, full body

presets.name: my-character
presets.change: {who} becomes the recurring character in @image1, identical face and outfit as in @image1, same performance.
refs: the same character reference in every video of the series

presets.name: new-location
presets.change: Move the whole scene to {location} as in @image1, which is a frame of this same shot in the new place: new ground, walls, sky and background; same performer, same clothes, same movements and camera path, light motivated by the new place.

fill.location: e.g. a snowy alpine village path at blue hour

refs: target frame: this shot's first frame with the new place around the performer

presets.name: time-of-day
presets.change: Same place at {time}; the light direction and shadows change, nothing else.

fill.time: golden hour, blue hour, or night with practical lights

presets.name: weather
presets.change: Same place in {weather}: wet surfaces and reflections, the clothes reacting to it; same movements.

presets.name: era
presets.change: The scene becomes {era}: set, clothes, props and film look of the period; same movements and camera.

fill.era: e.g. a 1970s street on film stock

presets.name: sci-fi
presets.change: The scene becomes {world} as in @image1, same performer and movements, light from the new world.
refs: target frame or a world plate

presets.name: game-level
presets.change: The scene becomes the game environment in @image1 (exact architecture and palette), same performer, movements and camera path.
refs: the environment, ideally from a similar camera height

presets.name: anime
presets.style: a hand-drawn 2D anime feature film: clean ink lines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone, painted backgrounds
presets.change: {who} is a hand-drawn anime character with the same hair and clothes. The background ({place}) is hand-painted anime background art with flat colour areas and painted clouds.

fill.place: the place as seen, e.g. the seaside promenade, the sea and the sky

refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: clay
presets.style: stop-motion claymation: plasticine puppets with thumbprints, a handmade miniature set
presets.change: {who} is a plasticine puppet with the same hair and clothes. The background ({place}) is a handmade miniature set of clay, card and felt.
refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: 3d-feature
presets.style: a 3D animated feature film: stylised characters with slightly larger heads and hands, smooth stylised skin and sculpted hair, soft global illumination, a stylised 3D set
presets.change: {who} is a stylised 3D animated character with the same hair and clothes. The background ({place}) is a stylised 3D set: soft rounded shapes, sculpted clouds, clean simple surfaces.
refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: painterly
presets.style: a moving {medium} painting on textured paper or canvas: visible brush strokes that follow the motion
presets.change: {who} is painted with soft edges and a little underdrawing. The background ({place}) is loose {medium} washes and a few confident strokes.
refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: noir
presets.style: 1940s black-and-white film noir: hard key light, deep shadows, venetian-blind light, heavy grain
presets.change: {who} wears the same clothes, lit like a 1940s studio picture.
refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)
presets.note: Noir keeps photographic detail, so QA reads it as a re-grade; judge it by eye.

presets.name: pixel-retro
presets.change: {who} and the background ({place}) are drawn in this style.

fill.place: the place as seen, e.g. the seaside promenade, the railing, the sea and the sky

refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: comic-ink
presets.style: inked comic-book art: bold outlines, halftone shading, flat colour
presets.change: {who} and the background ({place}) are inked in this style.

fill.place: the place as seen, e.g. the seaside promenade, the railing, the sea and the sky

refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: animation-to-live
presets.style: photoreal live action: real people, real materials and real light
presets.change: {who} is a real person with the same hair and clothes; every surface is real.
refs: optional target frame: the first frame of this shot fully redrawn in the style (use it when the background stays photographic)

presets.name: market-variant
presets.change: Recast for {market}: the person becomes the person in @image1 and the setting becomes {setting} as in @image2; same action, timing and product handling; no signs or text.
refs: target frame with the new person
a plate of the new setting

presets.name: phone-to-studio
presets.change: Make it look shot by a film crew: clean motivated light, a cinema lens, graded colour; same people, framing and timing.

restyle_target_frame: @image1 is the first frame of the result: every frame must look exactly like it.
restyle_style_image: @image1 is a frame from a different film: copy only its style (line work, shading, colour, texture), never its content.
